notes: frame hash is SHA-256 over raw YUV 4:2:0 pixels
segment_frames=1 signs every frame; 30 signs once per second at 30 fps
a paced frame is late if it is not finished before the next is released
power is the PMIC rail sum, V*I over rails; not wall power
mJ per frame is rail power above the idle baseline divided by frame rate
application-processor signer, not a secure element

ES256 rows: byte and Mbps fields come from a second run on 23 October 2026 (e6_video_es256.json) after ES256 signatures were changed to the 64-byte COSE form; the earlier DER values are kept as *_der. Frame rates, energy and telemetry stay from this run, so that every row shares one idle baseline (the second run's baseline was 0.06 W lower, on a cooler board).
